module MyGem
  # Deprecator instance. ActiveSupport::Deprecation.warn is no longer a public
  # class method in Rails 8.0+, so warnings must go through an instance.
  def self.deprecator
    @deprecator ||= ActiveSupport::Deprecation.new("2.0", "MyGem")
  end

  def self.old_api
    deprecator.warn("old_api is deprecated")
    42
  end
end

module MyGem
  # Deprecation instance (Rails 8+ no longer exposes ActiveSupport::Deprecation.warn
  # as a public class method, so an instance must be created and used).
  # The horizon "2.0" is the version in which old_api will be removed.
  def self.deprecator
    @deprecator ||= ActiveSupport::Deprecation.new("2.0", "MyGem")
  end

  def self.old_api
    deprecator.warn("old_api is deprecated")
    42
  end
end

module MyGem
  DEPRECATOR = ActiveSupport::Deprecation.new("2.0", "MyGem")

  def self.old_api
    DEPRECATOR.warn("old_api is deprecated")
    42
  end
end

module ReportFormatter
  # Formats a time using Rails' :db named format, e.g. "2026-01-02 03:04:05".
  def self.stamp(time)
    time.to_fs(:db)
  end

  # Formats a date using Rails' :long named format, e.g. "January 02, 2026".
  def self.long_date(date)
    date.to_fs(:long)
  end
end

class UsersController < ActionController::API
  def create
    render json: user_params.to_h, status: :ok
  rescue ActionController::ParameterMissing, ActionController::BadRequest
    render json: { error: "bad request" }, status: :bad_request
  end

  private

  # params.expect (Rails 8+) only permits the listed keys, drops unpermitted
  # keys, and raises a 400-mapped error when user is not a nested object.
  def user_params
    params.expect(user: [:name])
  end
end

    render json: user_params, status: 200
  end

  private

  # params.expect (Rails 8.0+) raises ActionController::ParameterMissing when
  # user is not a nested hash (e.g. a plain string), which Rails maps to HTTP 400.
  # Only the permitted keys (name) are returned; unpermitted keys are dropped.
  def user_params
    params.expect(user: [:name])
  end
end
